entities.summary: Olav Aukrust was a Norwegian poet and teacher. He popularized the use of Nynorsk as a literary language and is most commonly associated with his poem Himmelvarden (1916). Olav Aukrust was a writers & intellectuals from Lom Municipality (1883-01-21, Lom Municipality–1929-11-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
